tc02_test_specification.name: Framework Retrieval Runtime Test
tc02_test_specification.query: How do I practice Completion with Integrity when closing projects?

verified_mechanisms.trigger_node: When clicking ‘Execute workflow’ (manualTrigger v1) receives the pinned item containing { json: { query: '...' } }.
verified_mechanisms.query_normalizer: The downstream 'Query Input & Normalizer' node reads firstItem.json.query and normalizes the target coaching query.
verified_mechanisms.task_broker_isolation: N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_PORT=5699 isolates secondary CLI execution process from main n8n web daemon (port 5679).

safety_guards: Asserts data.workflowData.id === 'TSvKBGpM9nK7eb3U' at runtime; throws immediately if any other workflow is invoked.
Asserts GENX_TEST_QUERY environment variable is present and non-empty.
Injects query into manualTrigger via in-memory pinData without writing to workflow JSON or database.
Database row counts strictly asserted before and after execution (pre == post, mutations == 0).
Workflow remains inactive (active: false) before, during, and after execution.

proposed_execution_command.underlying_container_command: docker exec -e N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_PORT=5699 -e NODE_OPTIONS=--require=/data/tc_runner_bridge.js -e GENX_TEST_QUERY="How do I practice Completion with Integrity when closing projects?" genx-n8n n8n execute --id=TSvKBGpM9nK7eb3U
